r: Hey, what's the matter with you?
Looks like a bit of a fever. Just stay in bed for a few days.

brv_employee_03.m: But I can't! I mustn't! Gnossath would kill me.

brv_employee_05.m: He lent me money, so that I could afford this house. But no work - no money. I fear that if I can't pay my debts, Gnossath will take my house.
r: Maybe I could help you? I could do your work.
That's the way it goes, man. Have a nice day.

brv_employee_06.m: You would do that? Oh, thank you! Thank you!
r: I have too good a heart.
Yes. He wants me to carry heavy boulders.
Yes. It is hard work, really.

brv_employee.1: The dam is very important to Brimhaven. It should be repaired.
brv_employee.10:
Stebbarik was ill at home in bed. He could not work and feared that he would lose his job. Because of his high debts, he feared that Gnossath would then take his house away.
I have offered to do the work for Stebbarik.
brv_employee.30: Gnossath has asked me to carry 25 heavy boulders from the stock to the dam.
brv_employee.40: I have carried the first boulder to the dam.
brv_employee.41: I have carried 5 boulders to the dam.
brv_employee.43: I have moved 15 boulders. This work is exhausting!
brv_employee.90: Finally - that was the last boulder! Gnossath was very pleased with my work.
